description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Kefka)] and [Darkness Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Kefka)
description.text: Darkness abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Dark Justice after using three Darkness abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode II (Kefka)], removes [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Kefka)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode II (Kefka)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Darkness abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Darkness abilities, grants [Dark +50% Boost 1] and [Instant Cast 1] to the user when removed

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
